title.value: Options of Interest: Temporal Abstraction with Interest Functions
title.justification: The title is directly taken from the provided research paper.
title.quote: Options of Interest: Temporal Abstraction with Interest Functions

analysis.description: This paper introduces a generalization of initiation sets for options in reinforcement learning known as interest functions. The authors present a gradient-based learning algorithm which includes interest functions, resulting in a new interest-option-critic architecture. This architecture is capable of learning interpretable and reusable temporal abstractions, which are demonstrated through experiments in both discrete and continuous environments.

type.justification: The paper discusses the empirical investigation through quantitative and qualitative results in various environments, both discrete and continuous, to demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed approach.
type.quote: We demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed approach through quantitative and qualitative results, in both discrete and continuous environments.

name.justification: The paper discusses learning skills in reinforcement learning using temporal abstraction and options framework, which are central concepts in Reinforcement Learning.
name.quote: In this work, we tackle the problem of learning such skills in reinforcement learning (RL).

name.justification: The paper focuses on temporal abstraction in reinforcement learning, specifically through the options framework and interest functions.
name.quote: Temporal abstraction refers to the ability of an agent to use behaviours of controllers which act for a limited, variable amount of time.

name.justification: This is a key concept discussed for learning in reinforcement learning through the use of initiation sets and interest functions.
name.quote: The options framework describes such behaviours as consisting of a subset of states in which they can initiate, an internal policy and a stochastic termination condition.

name.justification: The Interest-Option-Critic architecture is introduced and discussed extensively as the primary model in the paper.
name.quote: We derive a gradient-based learning algorithm for interest functions, leading to a new interest-option-critic architecture.

is_contributed.justification: The Interest-Option-Critic architecture is a new model proposed in the research and is a contribution by the authors.

is_compared.justification: The Interest-Option-Critic model is compared with other models such as Option-Critic (OC) and Proximal Policy Option-Critic (PPOC) in their experimental results.
is_compared.quote: The IOC agent is able to converge in almost half the time steps needed by the OC agent.
